syllabus_topics: Binary, octal, and hexadecimal numbering systems
Logic circuits: binary logic and logic gates
Circuits with NAND and NOR gates
Basic sequential circuits: latches and flip-flops
Synchronous sequential circuits: Mealy and Moore machines

assessment_methods.method: Theoretical component (Normal Period Exam and/or Recourse Period Exam)

assessment_rules: For first-time students, the final grade (NoteENER) is 0.5 * max{ExamEN; ExamER} + 0.5 * Lab. For approval, a minimum grade of 8.0 is required in both the theoretical component and the laboratory component. All laboratory assignments are mandatory, and one unjustified absence leads to failure. Repeating students with a lab grade from the previous two years may use it, but cannot enroll in new labs. In the special period, the exam (ExameEE) accounts for 100% of the grade (NoteEE = 1.0 * ExameEE). The final grade is Note Final = max{NoteENER; NoteEE} and must be >= 9.5 for approval. Fraud in any assessment leads to annulment of involved parties' tests and will be reported.
